test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Callous
solution:
The correct answer is '**brutal**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given word** 'callous' **means not caring about the feelings or suffering of other people.(दूसरों की भावनाओं या पीड़ा की उपेक्षा करते हुए; कठोर हृदय, बेदर्द, निष्ठुर, संवेदनाहीन)

 
 
• ***Example:** He should not be **callous** about the safety of his cowerkers.*
 
 
 
• The marked option 'brutal
